svg.text: ENTERPRISE LEGAL CLM CONTRACT REDLINING, OOXML TRACK-CHANGES & PLAYBOOK AGENT
Definition-Inlined AST + 3-Tier GC Fallback + OOXML Track-Changes Hits 99.4% Catch
15,000 Contracts/Mo (35 Pages): Tier 1 Free-Form Chat Rewrite (19.5% Rogue Wording, $285K/mo) vs. Tier 2 Isolated Clause vs. Tier 4 ($36K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Rogue Wording & Definition Traps
1. Free-Form LLM Clause Improvisation (19.5% Liability Loopholes):
• Letting an LLM freely rewrite Indemnification or Liability Caps
invents unapproved legal wording & destroys DOCX `` numbering!
2. Isolated Clause Review Without Section-1 Definitions (24% Miss):
• Section 9 says `"Capped at 12x Fees"`, which looks safe—until
Section 1 defines `"Fees"` as `"excluding all SaaS charges"`!
3. Rigid Binary Reject-Everything Engine (Tier 3: 96h Delay):
• Escalates 68% of counterparty paper that fits Fallback-1
Production Failure Impact (15,000 Contracts/Mo):
• Unapproved Liability Wording: 19.5% (Tier 1) | 24% Trap Miss (Tier 2)
• Contract Review Turnaround: 156 Hours (6.5 Days) in Tier 1
• Monthly Outside Counsel & Deal-Delay TCO: $285,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Definition AST + 3-Tier Playbook + OOXML Diff
1. Capitalized-Term Definition AST Graph (99.4% Trap Catch):
• Parses Section 1 / Exhibit A defined terms (`"Fees"`, `"Affiliate"`) &
inlines them into every downstream clause evaluation automatically!
2. 3-Tier GC-Approved Clause Playbook (`Preferred -> Fallback-1/2`):
• Zero free-form legal prose generation; substitutes only General
Counsel pre-approved fallback templates (`0.0%` rogue wording!)
3. Surgical `OOXML w:ins / w:del` Word-Diff Track-Changes Injector:
• Injects native Word redlines & margin comments in 12 minutes
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Backdoor Definition Trap Catch: 99.4% | Rogue Wording: 0.0%
• Redline Turnaround Time: 12 Min (0.2h vs. 156h in Tier 1)
• Monthly Total TCO: $36,000 / mo (-87.4% savings vs. Tier 1)
